current_blocker_summary: Shift 96 proved the DIR-023 primitive defect in pinned go-apfs-v2: CreateContainer resolves FixedTime into builder.timestamp and volumeSuperblock writes it to FormattedBy.Timestamp, but never assigns apfsSuperblock.LastModTime. The struct field maps to reader VolumeSuperblock.ModificationTime at offset 256; v0.3.1/main has the same omission. Next action is an evidence-backed mechanism to set LastModTime with correct serialization/checksum before bounded verification; metaCryptoKeyOsVersion remains a separate proven mismatch.
